stem: Why did many farmers, artisans, and former Anti-Federalists support the Democratic-Republican Party?

options.label: A
options.text: The Democratic-Republicans favored the expansion of a strong national government.

options.label: B
options.text: The Democratic-Republicans supported strict restrictions on immigration.

options.label: C
options.text: The Democratic-Republicans supported the use of tariffs.

options.label: D
options.text: The Democratic-Republicans favored states’ rights and the rights of the common man.
